339-677-997-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha, causing you to scry 1
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2403-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

719-3413-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

513-5436-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-5436-6896.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

1445-3967-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3967-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

539-3334-3899-4552-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2113-6218-6627.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3259-7175--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7175--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

147-2438-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

141-5231-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4377-4423-6850-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4377-4423-6850-6886.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

1238-2351-4452-5467-6797.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

997-6243-6288.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

618-1734-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

957-1750-1979-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
957-1750-1979-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Time Stretch from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2921-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature and/or Food.
2921-5776-5777.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature or Food.
Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3152-3923-5570.notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least three counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
3152-3923-5570.description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.
If Nardole has at least four counters on it, this combo nets infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, and you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.

2223-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Anurid Scavenger triggers, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your draw step, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.

2665-2743-4365.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

933-2493-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
